topology: One large logical SSD (one FIFO). Eight storage clients have independent quotas, file buckets and restore arenas. No member disks are simulated.
natural_restore: Memory replicas take priority. Disk-only objects use staging at the file owner and a separate H2D transfer to the requesting TP rank.

kv.basis: Single B300 TP8 node, K3 MXFP4, FP8 KV, utilization 0.95, max length 1048576. Reported 55.0 GiB per GPU, rounded. Convert with the pinned local hybrid geometry. Endpoint latency is a separate comparator.

topology.basis: The eight 3.84 TB DGX cache devices supply the capacity budget only. This study represents 30.72 TB with one modeled SSD, a 24 TB KV budget and eight 3 TB client quotas.

leases_eviction.basis: Pinned Mooncake 0.3.14 defaults for ordinary read leases, memory high watermark and eviction ratio.

offload.basis: Eager offload, initial poll at service start, then a 10 s wait after work. Virtual clients start together. At heartbeat completion, reclaim above 90% to at most 80% of the per-client disk quota using native FIFO bucket selection. Usage is accounted in payload bytes.

prefill.basis: K3 2P+2D, eight B300 per prefill node, EP8, SGLang. Per-node active prefill throughput about 22k tokens/s with an 8192-token chunk. Cross-engine proxy for fresh tokens.

decode.basis: K3 CUDA graph step p50, eight GB300, 8192-token context, TP8/EP8/DCP8, synthetic routing. Interpolate batches 1 through 8. Context scaling and mixed steps are uncalibrated.

host_copy.basis: Pinned 1024 MB cudaMemcpy, per GPU, 20 iterations. Optimistic local-copy proxy. Fixed control time is set to zero. NUMA, cross-rank contention, RPC and filesystem overhead need calibration.

ssd.basis: Use 6.8/5.0 GB/s from the single Micron 7450 PRO E1.S surrogate as the default read/write service of one FIFO. 4x and 8x are optional service-rate sensitivities on the same device.

restore.basis: Model file-owner restore space and a destination copy, with per-object pipelining within connector sub-batches. Use the host_copy H2D proxy until target measurements are available.

volume.service_model: One bidirectional FIFO. All scenarios use one logical device. The optional speedup scales this device only.
